text_block_list.text:
Summer camp starts today, and Biwa
Hayahide
and I are dropping our
luggage off when we run
into some
familiar faces.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It looks like we've all arrived at the same
time.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go all out and get super fast here at camp! Fast enough to win the Kikuka Sho!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Taishin! You could at least pretend to be
excited
for me!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Why should I when everyone is thinking
the same
thing?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I'm planning to win it too.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Hehe, I have no intention of losing!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And so, the summer camp of classic year
begins!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
